verdict.rationale: Zapier documents centralized connected-account management (existing app connections carry over automatically), team-level MCP server access controls (view/edit permissions for teammates on Team/Enterprise plans), and account-level restrictions with managed connections/workspace controls plus SOC 2/SAML SSO security — directly matching the credential-sharing and access-control story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of granular per-credential permission enforcement and detail on classic (non-MCP) shared-connection admin workflows.
